I went to use it in Feb 2026 and it says I have to pay $59 for lifetime use. I think if I already paid to purchase the extra features once, I shouldn’t have to pay again, not to mention more than 3x more than what I already paid last time.

I sleep better. The sound is very relaxing and it helps me go to sleep better. It is really helpful to have. Sounds like this. I love how you can choose whatever you want no matter what you wanna listen to.

This is a very good app. It’s a very fun app with lots of music and you can even record your own songs. And you can also do lots of sounds.
New price not paying again!. I paid before. Not paying again. That price hike is ridiculous.
great for focus & sleep. Not just for kids. the white noise and the rain and city sounds and whatever you choose create a great atmosphere and an even better background for music on other apps.
Love this app!. Been using this app since my daughter was a baby. She’s 6 now. The only thing we wish, was more free sounds. Either way, we still love it.
Coooooool oh and I’m cute and irresistible. Cute and irresistible
Disappointed. I have used this app for years but have been devastated to open it only to see that now you have to pay for the vast majority of the sounds. Very, very disappointing.
Suddenly charging $60/year, thanks.. I paid for the app years ago. Now it’s a subscription?

Selfish. I’ve been using this app for years, and had 5 of my own mixes created to help me sleep. I go into the app to use it, and the company locked most of the sounds and you now have to pay money. There are 100 sounds and now you can only use 16 so 84% of the sounds are behind a paywall. ABSOLUTELY APPALLED.

Randomly stops playing. Randomly stops playing and when I exit the app and go back in it just flashes when I choose something to play. Not awesome when it happens in the middle of the night while I’m trying to get a child back to bed

Wow….. The more time I spend in this app, the better it is…. So many choices in each category that you can overlay either in the same category, or while in one that you like, switch to another category and choose one to overlay! And you can make numerous recordings of your own to use as well of things your baby loves, like voices or my son-in-law playing his guitar while my daughter sings… Fantastic!
Thinking of using this app for my own sleep time until my grandchild arrives! Truly a gift, and we’ll worth the small price!
Great Guava. This app helps me go to sleep every day! It’s awesome! Get Guava!

Great app for sleep!. I downloaded this app 7 years ago when my wife and I were blessed with twin boys. They still listen to the same sounds we made for them when they were babies. 

I used it when traveling for work. Don’t think about it just download it and you can thank me later.

UI suggestions. I have a suggestion of improvement for the UI if this app. 

The volume button can be better placed. 
Sometimes when I swipe up to go to another app, the like button goes full on volume 100% instead and scares everyone including my (sometimes already sleeping) baby. 
Swiping left/right for volume should not be near swiping up and down.

Life saver. We travel a lot as a family with 2 little boys. This App has been a constant used when we try to make bedtime routine away from home… the boys feel more confortable sleeping in a new place because I can bring a piece of home just by finding the right sound.
I get good sleeps. This helps me get better sleeps and it has plenty of noises to choose from

Excellent. I’ve had this app for several years and I always go back to it. I used it for our son, then our daughter and now for myself. I like the different sound choices as well as the ability to mix the sounds. It’s also nice to be able to adjust the sound level and the main speaker at different levels. Love it, worth it.

Perfect App for everyone. As a babysitter there are so many new things that come out every so often. This app I have been using for 6 years. It’s wonderful not just for getting kids I babysit to sleep but also for myself when I am working or needing a rest this app makes relaxing easier. I use the lightening sound the most it reminds me of sleeping through a storm. And it’s wonder to use on my niece and my nephew to help ease them for Naps and sleep.

Great app but. I use the app and purchased the lifetime version. However want to share it with my wife but she isn’t getting the purchased version. This is the first app I’ve seen doing this. Is this a glitch ?

Thanks for helping our babies sleep
Healing. The sounds return me to MySelf
Great app. Worth $12 lifetime payment. Great app.

The app is great. I purchased the app in 2019. I’ve had on my device in my iCloud account since then. My new phone. Same iCloud account. I redownload all my apps and now I have to pay $2 after I already paid for the app years ago. Full price. All my sound mixes showed up, purchased restored…. But now I have to pay? 

Seems like a scam or fraud to me. Charge people. Then change it to a subscription fee later. $2 a month. $24 a year. From every other person with the same situation. I wonder how that adds up?

best app ever!!. This app is amazing. I was thinking about buying a white noise machine or the little shush noise machines then I discovered this app. Even before paying the one time payment of 12 dollars to unlock everything it was still great. I’ve found that the actual white noise sound works the best with my baby and she is sleep within 5 minutes and when she’s fussy it calms her down almost immediately. She even enjoys watching the little animations. This app has everything from animations to lullabies to shush sounds to soothing music/sounds it even has a little light which may not work the best but works good enough.

Used this app with both my babies!. Would highly recommend for every parent/grandparent/caregiver to have on their phone! Getting to pick your own sequences and so many options that work so well for nap and bedtime!!!

Perfection for baby and now me. I got this almost 6 years ago for my iPad to help with calming my colicky baby. The fact that you can mix so many sounds, adjust individual sound volumes, and even record your own shushing or humming or whatever, is amazing! It's fun to experiment with all the options. 

Now that my kiddo is older, I have kept the app for when I'm having trouble sleeping or want to sleep in and block the noise of the kids. I turn on the app, pop in my earbuds, and head back to sleep while my husband holds down the fort. I thought I would have deleted it by now, but I cannot imagine being without it!
Ts’great. Ts’great

Warning- does not have family share support. I was very surprised to learn that the app does not support family share. I find it unacceptable that I will need to purchase this app twice to use with both parents devices.

Otherwise, this app would have been great.

Love this reliable app. I only use the free sound loops but they are so good and I use the water sounds almost every night for myself. I love that you can layer sounds and that there are no interruptions to the app. The loops will pause when my phone alarm goes off or when a call comes through, but it will continue playing once the alarm or call is cleared. I didn’t know about this app when my child was a baby, but I’m sure it would have come in handy in those early weeks. This is seriously one of my favorite apps of all time.
Pay to play 🙄. App is great but only about 1/8 of content is actually free. You either pay a subscription or make a one time purchase for $12-15.

Best app purchase yet!. I never write reviews but am so impressed with this app I had to write one. Absolutely love it! The design is genius and there are so many really good options for white noise and music plus the shushing! Well worth the lifetime purchase.
Love it !!. As a new parent I love this app it has different sounds you can play and also play at the same time. My baby loves the rain sound it’s so peaceful best app in the game and FREE!!!
Cool. Sounds, baby, sleep.....works. Wow
Definitely works. Gonna be honest, it’s the first result when I searched for a noise app, while my newborn was screaming in gas pain. Downloaded it immediately, and have been using it ever since.
Excelente. Una app muy útil y relajante!!
Great white noise app, not just for kids. Loved this app when my kids were little, still love it as my own personal white noise app. Would love to see a widget feature added.

Crying baby. I’ll start by saying that postpartum depression is real! I don’t and didn’t have it but felt like I was on the verge many nights. My baby wouldn’t take a pacifier and therefore had no idea how to soothe herself and would want to nurse constantly or cry. This app was a game changer for me. I highly recommend paying the extra to unlock all features. I thought the shush portion would be a total joke but it worked like a charm. Not sure how the creators knew that these things would work, but I thank God they did. It’s nothing short of amazing!
Get it!. The shusing sounds are livesaving!!

Night Sound- High pitch barking. I love this app! I use it every night. I wish so badly that the Night sounds didn’t have a high pitched squeak barking sound happening in the background. It is my favorite one setting, it reminds me of summer camping, but after a while that barking stands out so much I change it.
Otherwise love the app!
Sleep saver. I have a 2 year old struggles to fall asleep and stay asleep and this app has been a lifesaver on many a night.

Deceived. I paid for the app. When I downloaded a second time on my phone, I’m being required to pay again in order to be able to listen to all of the sounds. After you download it, leave it alone. I had to delete it because I didn’t have enough memory on my phone. However, after you paid the whole fee for it, you shouldn’t be required to pay again.

The only app that works. My 2 month old has colic and this is the only app I have found that has a colic sound. It’s basically just a few sounds already mixed together but this will seriously have her sleeping in minutes! So grateful I found this! I’ve tried using another white noise app that worked for my other kids and she was not having it. The ability to pick and choose the sounds and mix them with whatever sound level you desire for each individual sounds is nice.
Rain. My baby loves the sound of the rain.
Mrs can’t sleep. Love this app works on putting me and the baby to sleep.

Noise cuts out. I have this installed on my iPhone and iPad. It works fine on the iPhone and I can continue to use the phone to search the internet while the noise runs with no interruptions. When I play noise on my iPad, the noise skips terribly if I browse through the internet. Sometimes it cuts off. Kind of annoying so I may delete it and find something else for the iPad.

Wonderful app. So easy to use and customize. I use this when I sleep with my windows open, as it drowns out the street noise nicely. My only complaint is that it’s not compatible with Google home. Everything else about this app is fantastic!
Hello. I’m not a baby, I’m a senior, but I use rain on a tin roof every night! Thanks!

FANTASTIC!! RECOMMENDED. I happen to get in when it was $5.99 for lifetime... and not going to lie... WORTH IT! Definitely RECOMMENDED!! 
Options are boundless, doesn’t bother you, no data collection it’s as stated above, fantastic! Have a great day all!
yes. this app is literally amazing! i love all the awesome features it has and that even if you cant pay it has great sounds. love it! ❤️
Fantastic. We’ve tried multiple white noise apps, and Guva is by far the best. It’s a life saver when we travel and don’t have our white noise machine. Well worth the money.

Excellent Sound App. I’ve used this for myself and my family since it first launched and it has only gotten better. Not only have we used it at night/naptime for our kids, but the sound loops are perfect background noise for reading, game night, playtime, etc.
.
On a personal note, I’d love to have some inside train/sleep car sounds and more thunderstorm sounds. Have you ever thought of allowing the sounds to be played intermittently. You could have one sound set to play steady, while other sounds would fade in/out often, occasionally, and even rarely. For instance, steady rain sounds, with occasional thunderstorms playing, and wind playing rarely.
.
Thanks for the continued additions of the loops and the stellar content!
Bug. Bug! I now can’t access the shush, it’s overlapped with the record tab. I don’t know what’s going on! I need shushing!
Love it. My kids are grown now. No more babies but I find that I like to listen to the soft sounds or the music which is so relaxing. Especially like to hear when I am reading my Bible.
Game Changer. Changed our lives with our 7 week old. This app is a must have for new parents!!!

Haven’t had success with sound machines - thank god i found this app.. My LO is 2 months old and before having people everyone raved about sound machines. Unfortunately I did not have luck with sound machines. It felt as if my LO just wanted me singing or shushing not a machine. Saw this app online and decided to give it a try even paid the 13 dollars for the year and do not regret it one bit. Love the that it’s different things like loops, lullabied, etc. My little one enjoys the colic sound and the “night” loop. Always helps when getting him to sleep.
Great app. I don’t even have any babies~ I just love this for sleep.

Baby noise. My partner downloaded this i think it WAY to expensive for what it is our baby don’t care for it but I liked playing with the sounds and stuff for a good ten min I can see where others would like this app I just don’t see it being right to charge some one 10 dollars for noise I don’t think it’s right
Good app. This app is pretty good but you have to get the premium to use it.There is not much you can use.

Baby Sleeping. I have my great granddaughter for the weekend. Her parents went to Texas. I was told she was a picky sleeper and could only sleep with someone. I was not having a one year old sleeping between my husband and myself. I had them bring her playpen over with a nice mattress. I gave her a nice bath and looked for a little music to help her. I found your great sounds for lullaby’s. She started listening to my choice of rain and wind. She was down for the count. I put her in the playpen before she was fast asleep. It was like she was being serenaded. Thank you so much. We will definately be using again tomorrow. Good night!

Amazing. This app worked so great with my first we bought the full version. It was well worth it! My second loves it just as much. It is great because it plays while you use your phone. Great for the doctors office after baby gets shots play the rain or one of the animations and calms baby right down!
Best app ever. This app puts my baby to sleep within minutes. I love it!!!
Payment. I paid lifetime but it doesn’t work.

If you have a baby, GET THIS APP!!. This app is a complete game changer! I hardly ever write reviews so when I do it’s very good or very bad. Got recommended this app and I was NOT disappointed! My 6 week old baby is currently sleeping like a champ, just started using this tonight. Being able to use and mix multiple sounds is amazing. So far we like rain + waterfall😍 thank you so much to the creators for designing this app, we’re in love! Praying for many many more nights of sound sleep❤️

Overall good. I like but they should have more free options
Best app of all time!. Amazing. My favorite is wind + thunder. I will never sleep again without this on.
Don’t update. Update got rid of a lot of free sounds

Nice!. Just one day to using this app to help my baby sleep I say it’s wonderful, because it keeps my son calm and he gets super sleepy! Thanks y’all! Just wished all sounds were cheaper😅
Better than a Rohm. We have been using this since she came home from the hospital. Only thing she can rest with!

No response from customer service on mistaken purchase. I accidentally purchased this app - I downloaded the free version initially and the option to purchase repeatedly popped up on my screen. I accidentally touched the screen when the purchase option was present and somehow Apple Pay went to work without me purposely choosing to purchase the app. I emailed customer service about my mistaken purchase twice and never received a response.
User-friendly and So helpful. Just a couple quick clicks and I can drown out noise that would otherwise distract my baby from drifting off to sleep. Love it. Doesn’t use a ton of battery either 👍🏻

Baby fast asleep. My baby use to only sleep in his swing or cuddled up and then we could move him to his bed. Now within minutes of putting him in his bed and using this app he’s fast asleep. We use the birds, car ride, ocean, and rain mixture. The only downfall I wish there were more options without upgrading to the premium version.
Tons of helpful sounds. My baby ONLY goes to sleep to this particular rain sound. We don’t understand why, but it’s working and that’s all that matters.
Love it!. There are lots of sounds, recordings, music and the option to make your own recording. I use it all the time with my son!

Amazingly wonderful app. I’ve used this app on multiple devices and when I was younger I baby sat so threw multiple kids as well and now with my own kids. I bought the rest and don’t regret it at all. Honestly kinda wish I had the first time I ever used it. Definitely worth what they asked at the time. Wonderful product and simple easily navigated design couldn’t ask for more!!!!

Simple.. Great app, easy to use, and being able to overlay multiple sounds and music is great! The coolest surprise feature I found: I have Sonos speakers in my place, and I have the Sonos app, I clicked the familiar icon on the bottom right in this app when adjusting the volume, and it had my Sonos rooms there... click, and it’s in the room now!!! I’m not super techy, but I’m impressed, bravo!!
This app costs $8. Hidden behind IAP.. Most of the app is locked until you pay $8. But they don’t want to have the app cost $8 up front because that’s just silly, so it’s an IAP.

Love making custom sounds!. I really love how there’s SO many options, and the ability to layer sounds make this my go-to for white noise. I prefer a womb sound for my baby, and unfortunately the Womb option is a locked one until you pay, but I’ve found layering the Heartbeat, Deep Water, and Car Ride sounds create what I imagine it sounding like. Overall, a stellar app.

Gotta pay twice?!?. Come on. This app allows family sharing but NOT for in-app purchases. Umm, its a free app so whats the point? Give me a break guys. I bought the unlock. Dont make me buy it again for my wife’s phone/ipad. If ever there was an app for families, this is it. You need to make it easier on your paying customers, all of which are FAMILIES!
As an adult. Ik this app is for babies, I do not have a baby, but I really like this when I go to sleep.

Mom and Baby day THANKS!!. This is perfect! So many sound options and it works after I close my app screen. Nightlight feature is great! Also, it’s awesome that I can combine sounds to find my daughter’s perfect mix! Haven’t tried recording myself yet but I intend to! 10/10, really awesome!
Thank you. I will now use my iPad for this app. It works with my Bluetooth for my granddaughter

A miracle!. My baby loves this app, it is amazing how quickly it puts him to sleep.

No preview or trial for most sounds. I downloaded to try out the shush sounds but am unable to preview any in this category without paying $8.99 to unlock. A lot of other sounds are also “locked” and you can’t even get a 5 second sample without paying. This app either needs a short trial period so we can test out the various locked sounds or they need a brief preview for each locked sound so folks can sample before paying.

1/20/2020 Update: I uninstalled this app because I couldn’t preview or sample a lot of the sounds I’m interested in without purchasing. I understand some sounds are free but would never pay without being able to listen to a preview. I hope the pay-before-play business model works for the developers and wish them much success :)

Perfect. I love being able to mix and match with this app. I think my favorite feature is that it doesn’t turn off with a timer unless you want it to. Great sounds available on the basic version. I love rain+deep sea+ fireplace
Not free!!. If you want any actually sounds you have to pay 8.99!!

Works wonders. This app is awesome!, After testing out a few sounds, the colic sound works perfect for my 8 week old. She could be fussy and fighting sleep for 15 minutes and within 30 seconds of turning it on, she’s out. Definitely would recommend.
Works wonders. This was magical for calming down my son as an infant and still works for him now, 10 months later. Must have for parents.
10 outta 10. I rarely write reviews for apps but this by far is the best app I’ve spent money on. Truly works.

Amazing. I never review apps. I hardly ever pay for them as well. However, this is amazing. I have an entire iPad just for sleep time with baby. This is the only thing that helped us through sleep regression. Thank you so much.

Game changer for my newborn. This app was an absolute game changer for my newborn. Special shout out to another reviewer who suggested pairing a Bluetooth speaker with your phone. I got this when my baby was 2 weeks old and the shushing sounds in particular has helped my baby sleep several hours straight. There is a popular baby shusher device on Amazon but it only goes on for 30 mins max. With this app, you can play the sounds all night long.
Love it! So calming!. This app is amazing! Love it so much for me and my toddlers! Sounds are continuous and calming!

Help Please!. I love this app. I am a doula and work with many babies and families. I tell clients to download this app all the time. But lately, it will just randomly stop. Nothing wakes a baby like sudden noise change. Please let me know if I can do anything to fix this. It is so frustrating trying to rush back into the app, wait for it to load, reselect my custom sounds and put them at the right levels all before the baby wakes.

Thank you in advance for your help.

Works wonders. I’ve been using the app since my daughter was born (she just made 1) and it never fails to work like a charm. In less than 5 minutes of me turning it on she’s already sleeping. Her favorite it the colic sound but they have other great options if you decide to purchase everything and I promise you won’t regret it great investment for 5 bucks!

An app worth every cent!!. I first got this app as the free version but as a mom and photographer, I needed the whole shabang! I do not even know where to start for this review but I can say that it has not disappointed me at all. Between making your own mixes and white noises, to the shushers and animations, my child that I use it mostly with falls asleep within minutes. I definitely recommend the full version!

Savior. I can’t count how many times this app saved me from a long night. Even if you don’t pay for the extras it still works. I highly recommend it soothes your baby instantly. If this doesn’t work try YouTube.
The app is awesome. But most of the things have to buy, otherwise its a great app
Best money spent on an App. I love this App! I used it to record my own shushing for my newborn and it worked great! Now I use a sound mix I put together to sleep every night.

But in the last few weeks it has a pop up begging for a rating right before I click the white noise button. Delaying me that much further when I have a baby on the verge of waking up. 

Program the prompt for after the selection, not before. Or - better yet - don’t ask for reviews from people that have paid to unlock everything.

App Stopped Working. The app was great until it stopped working. I have tried it on multiple devices, and deleted/redownloaded the app. The app immediately closes when I select the sounds icon from the main page.

Update: App has been fixed and is working great. Well worth the cost for all of the available sounds.

Great app!!. I has ALL the features that any parent would want or need in a white noise machine. The free version is great but if you decide to purchase the premium version, the price is very affordable! I am glad I found this App and didn’t have to spend big bucks in a sound machine! I definitely recommend this if you are in search of a good white noise app that soothes your baby in a safe way.

Absolutely love.. So I was using YouTube for white noise, rain sounds for my newborn but I found this app and absolutely love it! I’m so happy I found it. I can multitask on my phone while the app is playing any sound you want. It has many options. It’s so convenient if you’re on the road or anytime really. I use this app every single day. Both my babies love it. Thank you !

I loved this app until. I really really loved this app I didn’t even hesitate to for it until started making weird noises that scare my baby or would just stop by itself mayne they need to update it or something cause is a great app
Free app is 1 of 1000 others. The paid app might be okay but the free version is useless compared to the 1000 other, better sleep sound apps.
Great app. Even the free sounds are good. Just what we wanted!
Upgrade?. I love this app, however I tried to upgrade by unlocking the features and had no luck. The payment went through on my credit card but nothing got unlocked...

Amazing...started with baby now use myself. Rain + Wind + Womb. Enough said. I started using this as a travel noise machine for my baby, but now I love it. I just wish they had an actual machine for my room, so I don’t have to run my phone all night to use it. I do use this while traveling though and love it.

Love love love this app. Couldn’t live without this app. I upgraded and it was totally worth a few bucks. Both kids use this for naps and sleeping at night. I personalized with my own recorded sush, some light rain, and low pitch white noise. Thank you so much for making this app. It sure beats saying “shhhh” a million times!
Parents best friend. One of the tools we always use to soothe our baby girl. It has saved us countless times. A++++
Magic!. This app is a magic wand for our colicky baby who's now 6 months old. It has saved us..in the car, at night, during the day, to drown out the noise of his older siblings...worth every penny!

Best $5 I’ve ever spent!. My son LOOOVES the deep sea animation! He could be mid tantrum and as soon as I turn it on and he stops. It helps him fall asleep too. I also really like that I can record my own shush’s, because let’s be honest, that gets old real quick 😆 Buy this app, seriously.

High frequency noise. I bought the full app with the hope of accessing some lower pitched white noise (deep rumbly sound, like a large waterfall a mile away), which is the best for sleep. Unfortunately, even the deepest white noise in this app is too high pitched -- I listened to all of them. I would have happily just contacted the app developers to get my money back instead of leaving a review, but instead of just providing an email address, the app forces me to interact with Apple's built-in email platform.
App keeps crashing. App crashes under lock screen all the time. Otherwise seems good, clean UI and good sounds.
Love it. Works wonders my 2 month old loves the rain takes no time to put her to sleep with this app. It really is a life saver , would give 5 stars if every other sounds & etc weren’t locked !!

Amazing!!. Initially used this for my newborn son, but now I use it when I am studying and need white noise to block out what is going on around me. 

I love that there are so many sounds that are part of the free portion of this app. I have not upgraded to purchase the rest of the sounds, but I do feel like it would be worth it. However.... the free version gives me exactly what I need. 

Thank you from a sleepless new mom and a grad student :)

Crashes. I love the sounds and how you can mix and match them. I bought the $5 expansion. I just recently had a baby and these sounds are great for both me and baby. I also really love that I can let the sounds play and use your phone ....but....the app crashes several times a day. Nothing. NOTHING. Is more maddening when you’ve just got your baby to sleep w the help of this app and then it crashes to dead silence and your baby wakes up!! If this app was something physical, many times I would have stomped on it or tossed it out the window.

I Adore this App! In my Sleep ESSENTIALS.. They have so many sleep sounds that it is literally overwhelming, but just scroll through, find 5-6 that sound like nice white noise to you, then you can MIX those sounds to make a little concoction. My current playlist: Womb + car ride + deep sea. You can even adjust which sound is most prominent within your homemade mix. Basically, mine sounds like very low, steady, white noise, with soft, bass-y heartbeat. best of all, it plays ALL NIGHT LONG. I don’t know about other moms, but my baby will wake up the INSTANT anything on a timer shuts off. So i love that i can turn this timer off. We have a white noise machine at home , but this app is absolutely necessary for travel, just blast the white noise on my phone while I leave it on the charger near me and baby at a hotel, whatever... and of course, FOR NAPS! Hell yes, i use white noise for naps! It extended my 6 mo. Old’s naps by at least 15 minutes on average, at least. Plus, we always have our phones on us. You know you do. Just whip that baby out while you’re feeding/nap/bedtime routine-ing, once baby is out, you can still diddle around on other apps. I promise, you can still be on IG or google or baby center. PRO TIP: get a cheap Bluetooth speaker, and play this app through it, so you can take phone with you, leave baby with speaker. YOURE WELCOME.

A must have for newborns. Love the customization, and presets such as “baby colic”, which seems to instantly neutralize our newborn. My only complaint is going to the home screen shuts off the sounds, which is very easy to accidentally do.

Finally found good sounds. I downloaded multiple free apps for the rain sound so that when we traveled and my infant napped we still had a noise blocker. This was the only one I found that was pleasant. I love these sounds.
Love. I absolutely love this app for my grandson at nap time. He loves the animation ones it puts him in a daze and he falls fast asleep. It’s awesome 🥰
Wow. You get like 10 sounds for free. Anything else pay 4.99. Might as well just advertise it as $4.99. Dumb micro transaction app once again.
